description: Verify that echoUINT8 round-trip — DUT echoes the UInt8 value sent in Method Request
approach:
[Objective]
Unsigned 8-bit round-trip — the most basic byte-preserving check.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_payload_mismatch: echoUINT8 response payload did not match Request
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_response: No Method Response within listen window
